# clickbaitpaysus.com

The ClickBaitPays Guide by MTG, the same guide as https://mtgtribe.com/cbp, at this domain's root.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are built from mtglegacyai/mtgtribe (`cbp/_build/build.py`), which builds
mtgtribe.com/cbp and then this copy every time, so the two never drift apart (MTG, 22 Nov 2026). Videos: Cloudflare R2,
https://media.clickbaitpaysus.com/videos/. The old site (before 22 Nov 2026) is in this repo's history; its addresses forward
to the new pages.
